newsitem.title: USA: Interpublic to form sports marketing venture.
newsitem.headline: Interpublic to form sports marketing venture.

text.p: Interpublic Group of Cos Inc said on Wednesday that it entered a tentative agreement to form a venture with Kaleidoscope Media Group for marketing sports, entertainment and special events.
Interpublic will own a 51 percent interest in the Kaleidoscope Sports and Entertainment venture and certain Kaleidoscope affiliates will own the remaining interests, Interpublic said.
The PGA Seniors Tour, Skins Game, MTV Awards Show and the ESPY Awards are examples of properties developed by Kaleidoscope principals in the past, Interpublic said.
Financial terms of this deal were not disclosed.
